confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are based on aggregated crowdsourced cost-of-living figures for La Spezia (Expatica/Numbeo, combien-coute.net, MyLifeElsewhere, CityCost) and general Italian menu guides, which vary by source. Cocktail and wine anchors are weak: no reliable regional average was found, so cocktail is set at about 2.2 times the beer anchor and wine at about 1.1 times the beer anchor, per the local price relationship. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the city context; no accommodation searches were run and no live listings were checked. Coastal Cinque Terre and Portofino pricing may push some anchors higher in peak season. FX is the RBA 4.00 pm indicative rate for 18 November 2026 as reported in the RBA's published summary; the value was confirmed only through secondary reporting, so verify against the RBA F11 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with mid-sized Ligurian and northern Italian port and tourist cities such as Genoa, adjusted downward for the lower tourist density of La Spezia itself and upward for proximity to Cinque Terre tourism. Food prices are anchored to Italian national and Ligurian survey ranges; accommodation is a holistic estimate.
